Down — but not out. Hopefully these smiling young ladies will be with us for many years to come. Lucinda Blake, Genya Marek and the mighty atom Louise Collier take shelter beneath a Belgrave umbrella at St. Ives.

The rise in standard was not restricted to the senior women's team for Debbie Hearn was our highest placed runner of the afternoon when she came home 3rd in the under 17 race and Louise Collier and Genya Marek ensured that we were well represented in each of the other age groups.
